shortDescription: Module for setup of SSLKeyAndCertificate Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: ca_certs
options.description: Ca certificates in certificate chain. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: certificate
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: certificate_base64
options.description: States if the certificate is base64 encoded. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: certificate_management_profile_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type certificatemanagementprofile. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: configpb_attributes
options.description: Protobuf versioning for config pbs. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: created_by
options.description: Creator name. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: dynamic_params
options.description: Dynamic parameters needed for certificate management profile. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: enable_ocsp_stapling
options.description: Enables ocsp stapling. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- false), basic (allowed values- false) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: enckey_base64
options.description: Encrypted private key corresponding to the private key (e.g. Those generated by an hsm such as thales nshield). Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: enckey_name
options.description: Name of the encrypted private key (e.g. Those generated by an hsm such as thales nshield). Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: format
options.description: Format of the key/certificate file. Enum options - SSL_PEM, SSL_PKCS12. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as SSL_PEM.

options.name: hardwaresecuritymodulegroup_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type hardwaresecuritymodulegroup. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: import_key_to_hsm
options.description: Flag to enable private key import to hsm while importing the certificate. Field introduced in 22.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: is_federated
options.description: It specifies whether the object has to be replicated to the gslb followers. Field introduced in 22.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: key
options.description: Private key. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: key_base64
options.description: States if the private key is base64 encoded. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: key_params
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: key_passphrase
options.description: Passphrase used to encrypt the private key. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: markers
options.description: List of labels to be used for granular rbac. Field introduced in 20.1.5. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: name
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: ocsp_config
options.description: Configuration related to ocsp. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: ocsp_error_status
options.description: Error reported during ocsp status query. Enum options - OCSP_ERR_CERTSTATUS_GOOD, OCSP_ERR_CERTSTATUS_REVOKED, OCSP_ERR_CERTSTATUS_UNKNOWN, OCSP_ERR_CERTSTATUS_SERVERFAIL_ERR, OCSP_ERR_CERTSTATUS_JOBDB, OCSP_ERR_CERTSTATUS_DISABLED, OCSP_ERR_CERTSTATUS_GETCERT, OCSP_ERR_CERTSTATUS_NONVSCERT, OCSP_ERR_CERTSTATUS_SELFSIGNED, OCSP_ERR_CERTSTATUS_CERTFINISH, OCSP_ERR_CERTSTATUS_CACERT, OCSP_ERR_CERTSTATUS_REQUEST, OCSP_ERR_CERTSTATUS_ISSUER_REVOKED, OCSP_ERR_CERTSTATUS_PARSE_CERT, OCSP_ERR_CERTSTATU

options.name: ocsp_responder_url_list_from_certs
options.displayName: Ocsp Responder Url List From Certs
options.description: This is an internal field to store the ocsp responder urls contained in the certificate. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: ocsp_response_info
options.description: Information related to ocsp response. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: status
options.description: Enum options - SSL_CERTIFICATE_FINISHED, SSL_CERTIFICATE_PENDING. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as SSL_CERTIFICATE_FINISHED.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: type
options.description: Enum options - SSL_CERTIFICATE_TYPE_VIRTUALSERVICE, SSL_CERTIFICATE_TYPE_SYSTEM, SSL_CERTIFICATE_TYPE_CA, SSL_CERTIFICATE_TYPE_CLIENT, SSL_CERTIFICATE_TYPE_SECURE_CHANNEL. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.
